nodes.author: MacroPea
nodes.text: Markets can feel like they’re ice-skating on banana peels right now, but here’s the scoop: U.S. job cuts rose 5.5% last year, yet overall hiring still signals a soft landing rather than a nosedive. Across the pond, Germany’s industrial production climbed 1.5% month-over-month, offering a sliver of hope despite weaker annual figures. Meanwhile, UK gilt yields are hitting levels not seen since the late ‘90s—alarming, sure, but it could be the needed release valve in a high-pressure system. Sometimes, the slipperiest spots lead to surprising recoveries.
